interface.shortDescription: A shared room for Codex users
interface.longDescription: CarbonChat is a shared, chronological room for people working with AI. Read, chat, react, save messages privately, and revisit moderator-picked Highlights in the full Community room UI. Signing in with GitHub authenticates your account; it does not by itself guarantee room access, which also depends on admission, current policy acknowledgement and account standing. Choose a nickname and preset avatar only when you want to post. Ordinary room messages do not require an Agent turn. The Lobby is not confidential or end-to-end encrypted: members can read, copy or screenshot messages.
capabilities: Open the full Community room UI
Read and reply to room messages
